name: draft-in-voice
title: draft-in-voice
description: Ghostwrite content in a specific person's voice from a VALIDATED voice profile — tweets, replies, short posts, launch copy, recruiting blurbs, emails. Loads the subject's voice profile (people/<slug>-voice) plus first-party context from the brain, drafts 2-3 options in-register, then runs a hard voice-fidelity self-check before showing anything. Includes the profile BUILDER: if no validated profile exists, drafting hard-stops and this skill walks the corpus-to-fingerprint build instead. Never auto-posts.
